en: Fixed the InstructionsLoaded hook omitting agent\_id and agent\_type when a subagent's file access loads a rule or nested CLAUDE.md; rules and nested CLAUDE.md files loaded on file access now also report effort
zh: 修复了 subagent 的文件访问加载规则或嵌套 CLAUDE.md 时，InstructionsLoaded hook 遗漏 agent\_id 和 agent\_type 的问题；文件访问时加载的规则和嵌套 CLAUDE.md 文件现在也会报告 effort
